cues.en: If it's true that positive action by government is a mistake in as much as it tends to exacerbate situations that it set out to cure, wouldn't it follow that your proposal for a negative income tax might actually create a larger class of indolent and unemployed?
cues.zh: 如果政府积极行动之所以是错误，是因为它往往会加剧它本要治愈的状况，那这是否意味着，你提出的负所得税方案实际上可能制造出更大一群懒惰、失业的人？

cues.en: than existing programs or certainly than ideal programs. But first of all, you'd better explain your negative income tax because it's frequently misunderstood. Yes, it certainly is. The proposal for a negative income tax is a proposal to help poor people by giving them money, which is what they need, rather than as now...
cues.zh: ——比现有项目更大，当然也比理想项目更大吗？但首先，你最好解释一下你的负所得税，因为它经常被误解。是的，确实如此。负所得税方案是给穷人钱来帮助他们，给他们真正需要的东西，而不是像现在这样……

cues.en: by requiring them to come before a governmental official, detail all their assets and their liabilities, and be told that you may spend X dollars on rent, Y dollars on food, etc., and then be given a handout. The idea of a negative income tax is to treat people who are poor in the same way as we treat people who are rich. Both groups would have to file income tax returns, and both groups would be treated in parallel way. Under current law, if you or I file an income tax return, and we have, let's say,
cues.zh: 而是要求他们到政府官员面前，列清所有资产和负债，被告知房租只能花 X 美元、食物只能花 Y 美元等等，然后才拿到救济。负所得税的理念是，用对待富人的同样方式对待穷人。两个群体都得申报所得税，并且会以平行方式处理。按现行法律，如果你或我申报所得税，而我们假设有，比如说，

cues.en: I were a family of four, head of a family of four to take a simple guess. Well, I am, but as it happens, my children are grown up and they're not very good as, no good to me anymore as income tax deductions. That's one of the troubles with you kids growing up. Your parents lose you as a deduction. And you don't tithe their earnings? No, I'm afraid I don't tithe their earnings and I'm afraid in the modern day the parents continue to contribute to the children instead of the other way around. But under...
cues.zh: 假设我是一个四口之家，简单假设一下，是四口之家的户主。嗯，我确实是，但碰巧我的孩子已经长大，他们作为所得税抵扣已经——对我不再有用了。这就是孩子长大的麻烦之一。父母就失去了你这个抵扣项。而且你不从他们的收入中抽什一税？不，恐怕我不从他们的收入中抽什一税；恐怕在当代，父母还在继续补贴孩子，而不是反过来。但在……

cues.en: If I were still ahead of a family of four, I would be entitled to an exemption of $3,000 without paying a tax. That is, if I had an income of $3,000, I would have an exemption of $3,000, I would pay no tax. If I had an income of $4,000, I would have a positive taxable income of $1,000, I would be required to pay a tax on that thousand. Suppose I have an income of $2,000, then by the same arithmetic, I have a negative...
cues.zh: 如果我还需要养活四口之家，我就能享受3000美元的免税额，而无需缴税。也就是说，如果我收入3000美元，就有3000美元的免税额，无需缴税。如果收入4000美元，应税收入就是1000美元，需要为这1000美元缴税。假设我收入2000美元，按同样算法，我的应税收入就是负...

cues.en: taxable income of $1,000, minus $1,000 is my taxable income. The idea of the negative income tax is to apply a tax rate to that minus $1,000 and give a man a subsidy in proportion to it. For example, the highest rate, it seems to me, at all feasible to use would be 50%, and it makes it simple for arithmetic. Let's suppose a rate were 50%. Then if I had an income of $2,000,
cues.zh: 1000美元，减去1000美元就是我的应税收入。负所得税的思路就是对这负1000美元适用一个税率，按比例给予补贴。比如，我认为可行的最高税率是50%，这样算术也简单。假设税率是50%，那么如果我收入2000美元，

cues.en: with a family of four, I would be entitled to receive half of that thousand back. That is, I would get back $500 and end up with an income of $2,500 available to me. If I had zero income, if I had no income at all, then I would have a negative taxable income of minus $3,000. I would be entitled to receive half of that, or $1,500.
cues.zh: 四口之家，就有权拿回那1000美元的一半，也就是拿回500美元，最终可用收入是2500美元。如果我收入为零，完全没有收入，那么我的应税收入就是负3000美元，有权拿到一半，即1500美元。

cues.en: And in this way, this program would say nobody in the country, no family of four in the country, shall have a smaller amount than $1,500 available for it for its purposes of consumption. That would be the negative income tax. Now, the point that I think it's urgent to stress to avoid misunderstanding is that while there's a guaranteed income, a minimum guarantee of $1,500, that income is not equal to the breakeven point, the point at which you
cues.zh: 这样，这个方案就意味着全国任何人、任何四口之家，可用于消费的金额都不会低于1500美元。这就是负所得税。现在要紧急强调一点以免误解：虽然有保障收入、1500美元的最低保障，但这个收入不等于收支平衡点，也就是你

cues.en: Pay no taxes of 3,000 this difference is essential Because there are other proposals which have been made under the name of guaranteed income which would say let's set a Level like 3,000 then if a family has less than that will make up the difference Now the trouble with such gap-filling programs with the program Which says if you have less than 3,000 will make up the difference is that you destroy the incentive of people to earn anything Why should anybody go to work and earn anything now?
cues.zh: 不缴税的那个3000美元的点，这个差别至关重要。因为还有其他以保障收入为名的提案，它们会说设一个比如3000美元的水平线，家庭收入低于这个数就补足差额。这种填补缺口的方案，这种“低于3000美元就补差”的方案，问题在于它摧毁了人们去挣钱的动力。那现在谁还会去工作挣钱呢？

cues.en: under a 50% rate, you also weaken their incentive. And if you were starting from scratch, you might be adding to the problem. But you're not starting from scratch. Our present welfare programs, our present direct relief, and aid to dependent children programs, in effect, have a 100% tax rate. Because if a family on relief, if let's say a woman as currently is mostly the case under aid to dependent children, if a woman who is on relief takes a job and earns $100,
cues.zh: 在50%的税率下，你也会削弱他们的动力。如果你从零开始，可能还会加剧问题。但你不是从零开始。我们现行的福利项目、直接救济，以及对抚养子女的援助项目，实际上税率是100%。因为一个接受救济的家庭，比如说一位女性——目前抚养子女援助下大多如此——如果一位接受救济的女性找了工作，赚了100美元，

cues.en: And she's honest. She is required to have her relief payment reduced by $100. That's one of the ways in which we've been producing poor people. Yes, but it would be easy enough to modify that system without invoking your revolutionary substitute. Not at all. Impossible. How? Well, you say because it's politically difficult. No, no, no, never mind the political difficulty. How would you modify it? Well, presumably by permitting her to keep one half of that $100. Yes, but then look at what happens.
cues.zh: 而且她诚实。她的救济金就必须减少100美元。这正是我们不断制造穷人的方式之一。是的，但修改那个制度很容易，不必搬出你那套革命性的替代方案。完全不是。不可能。怎么改？嗯，你说是因为政治上困难。不，不，不，别管政治困难。你会怎么改？嗯，大概是允许她保留那100美元的一半。对，但接下来看看会发生什么。

cues.en: Let's suppose you go that route and now I have two people both of whom are working at the same job Both of whom have the same wage But one of them before he had that job or she had that job was on relief and the other was not The person on relief ends up with a higher income than the person who was not under the existing under your plan No under your plan if you were in fact, that's the plan yet, but no under under the plan you mentioned. Yeah
cues.zh: 假设你走这条路，现在我有两个人，都在做同一份工作，拿同样的工资。但其中一个在得到那份工作之前——他或她——在领救济，另一个没有。结果领救济的人最终收入反而高于没领救济的人，在现行制度下——在你的方案下——不，在你的方案下，如果你实际上……那还不是这个方案，但不对，在你提到的方案下。对。

cues.en: Under a plan where you said, well now four people on relief, if they get a job, we'll let them keep half their earnings. The effect of that is to treat people who ought to be treated the same differently. It's thoroughly inequitable, and I think nobody would stand for it very long. The virtue of an income tax arrangement is precisely that it treats everybody the same way. Anybody whose income is $2,000 with a family of four gets treated exactly the same way, and there's none of this unfortunate discrimination among people.
cues.zh: 在你说“好吧，现在有四个领救济的人，如果他们找到工作，我们就让他们保留一半收入”的方案下。其效果就是把本该同样对待的人区别对待。这完全不公平，我认为没人能长期容忍。所得税安排的好处恰恰在于它一视同仁。任何收入为2000美元、四口之家的人都会受到完全相同的对待，不会出现这种不幸的人与人之间的歧视。

cues.en: Well, I see that point, and it certainly is a logical extension of the whole idea of rule by law. But in fact, don't we know from the evidence of our senses that the poor really are divided into two categories. There are the poor who are victimized by circumstances, let's say a Negro who leaves the South, arrives in New York.
cues.zh: 嗯，我明白那个观点，这确实是法治整个概念的逻辑延伸。但事实上，从我们的感官证据中，难道我们不清楚穷人实际上分为两类吗？有一类穷人是环境的受害者，比方说一个离开南方、来到纽约的黑人。

cues.en: and finds that he is not in command of any negotiable skill, though he is anxious to work. That's one category, but the other category, and it is generally estimated that this would make up for about 50%, or the so-called disorganized poor, the people who are poor because they are completely unmotivated, and because there is some sort of a neurotic block that keeps them from acting in the way that under...
cues.zh: 他发现自己掌握不了任何可交换的技能，尽管他很渴望工作。这是其中一类，而另一类——普遍估计这大约占了50%——也就是所谓的无组织穷人，这些人贫穷是因为他们完全缺乏动力，并且某种神经官能症式的阻碍让他们无法按照……

cues.en: If you deal with universals, you would expect them to act. Now you say, or do you say they should be treated alike? What are you going to do with the poor person who having consumed his $3,000 or whatever it comes up to under the negative income tax, spends all of that on the races and then turns to the community and says, this is the second of January and I have consumed my years of income.
cues.zh: 如果你谈论普遍规律，你会期望他们会有所行动。现在你说，或者你是说应该对他们一视同仁吗？你打算怎么处理那个穷人：他在花光了负所得税发给他的3000美元（或者具体是多少钱）之后，把这些钱全都赌了马，然后转过头对社会说，现在是1月2日，我一年的收入已经花光了。

cues.en: Now, meanwhile, I have four children. Well, in the first place, the negative income tax wouldn't work along those lines. It wouldn't be a difference. I would treat the negative payments exactly the same way as you treat the positive income tax. What we do now is that the person who works files an exemption allowance and then...
cues.zh: 而且，与此同时，我有四个孩子。嗯，首先，负所得税不会按那种方式运作。它不会是个差额。我会像对待正所得税完全一样的方式来对待负所得税补贴。我们现在的做法是，工作的人提交免税额申请，然后……

cues.en: gets his tax deducted at source from his wage. In the same way, for a person who works under a negative income tax, he would end up having his wages supplemented, if he works, but his earnings are less than the exemption. He would end up getting his negative income tax, his pay check, the same way, so he'd get it weekly. In the second part, those who do not work, if there are those who are not work, are in the same position as those...
cues.zh: 他从工资中直接扣税。同样地，对于在负所得税制度下工作的人来说，如果他工作但收入低于免税额，他的工资最终会得到补贴。他会以同样的方式得到负所得税，也就是他的工资支票，所以他每周都能拿到。第二部分，那些不工作的人，如果有不工作的人，他们的处境和那些……

cues.en: who do not work but have a positive income. They are required to file, you and I are required to file, an advance estimate of income and to pay our taxes quarterly. Similarly, on the negative side, if you had people with low incomes, they would file an advance estimate of their annual... Such as zero. Zero, in which case it would be calculated out that they were entitled to receive so many dollars a week, or a month, and they would get it in weekly or monthly payments. Now suppose you did all that.
cues.zh: 不工作但有正收入的人一样。他们需要申报，你和我都需要申报预估收入，并按季度缴税。同样地，在负所得税方面，如果有些低收入的人，他们会申报年度预估收入……比如零。零的情况下，会计算出他们有权每周或每月领取多少美元，然后他们会按周或按月收到。现在假设你都做了这些。

cues.en: There undoubtedly would still be some people who were dissipated on booze or on the races. There are now. Is there any doubt whatsoever that people on relief are able to find ways of getting around? You may not be aware. I don't know how it works in Chicago, but for instance in New York, there are direct payments by some of the welfare agencies to houses, to landlords, that kind of business. And occasionally it goes so far at the discretion of the caseworker, direct payments to grocers.
cues.zh: 毫无疑问，仍会有一些人把钱挥霍在酒或赌马上。现在就有。难道还有任何疑问，接受救济的人能找到办法钻空子吗？你可能不知道。我不清楚芝加哥是怎么运作的，但比如在纽约，一些福利机构会直接向房东付款，这类操作。偶尔，在个案工作者的酌情决定下，甚至会直接向杂货商付款。

cues.en: so that X amount of shredded wheat, instead of X amount of pot, is delivered. Oh, I understand. But you and I understand the free market. And that shredded wheat, once delivered, doesn't have to stay in the home to which it's delivered. Let's not underestimate the ingenuity of the poor people in converting what they get from the relief worker to what they want. That's true. And that's just wasteful. They would be far better off if we just gave them the money and let them spend it. No, but it seems to me that some are very intelligent to critics of your proposal.
cues.zh: 这样发放的就是一定量的碎麦片，而不是一定量的大麻。哦，我明白了。但你我都懂自由市场。而且那些碎麦片一旦发放，就不必留在收货的家里。别低估穷人的聪明才智，他们能把从救济人员那里拿到的东西换成自己想要的东西。确实。而且这纯属浪费。如果我们直接给他们钱、让他们自己花，他们会好得多。不，但在我看来，有些批评你提案的人非常聪明。

cues.en: who are as wedded as you to the same ideals of freedom and so on, do make the point that in a full employment society...
cues.zh: 他们和你一样笃信自由等相同理想，也确实提出：在充分就业的社会里……

cues.en: When you have people who resist employment because they are under motivated, precisely what they then need is to be treated not as members of an equal category, but as individuals with individual problems, and that precisely what therefore is needed is the administration of welfare. Well, but let's take that argument. I think there's a great deal to the fact that many people do need this, but it's obvious that under present arrangements they don't get it. The welfare worker today does not really...
cues.zh: 当有人因为动力不足而抵制就业时，他们真正需要的恰恰是不被当作平等类别中的成员，而是被当作有各自问题的个体；因此真正需要的正是福利管理。嗯，但我们来顺着这个论点说。我认为，很多人确实需要这个，这一点很有道理，但很明显，在现有安排下他们得不到。今天的福利工作者并不真正……

cues.en: someone who is able. This is why welfare workers such an unattractive occupation because a welfare worker is not in a position to help the relief recipient. He is a policeman and a spy. He has to keep tabs on him to be sure he gets the money right now. So as a schoolteacher, you can say that about a schoolteacher. Yes, I would like to reduce the extent to which the schoolteachers are public servants and make them bring more competition into schools too. Do you consider it a spy in that rather perfidious sense?
cues.zh: 一个有能力的人。这就是为什么福利工作者是如此不吸引人的职业，因为福利工作者无法帮助救济领取者。他是警察，也是间谍。他必须盯着对方，确保对方现在拿到钱。所以说到教师，你也可以这样评价教师。是的，我想减少教师作为公职人员的程度，也让他们给学校带来更多竞争。你是在那种相当背信弃义的意义上把他看作间谍吗？

cues.en: if you actually look in to find out whether or not, let's say, the four babies have been fed in the last 36 hours, or whether they've been inoculated. That isn't what I was referring to. Well, I would assume not. I would assume not. But therefore, the kind of spying that goes with caseworking is an act really of patronage, isn't it?
cues.zh: 如果你真的去调查一下，比方说，那四个婴儿在过去36小时内有没有吃过东西，或者有没有接种过疫苗。我指的不是这个。嗯，我想应该没有。我想应该没有。但因此，伴随案例工作的这种监视，其实是一种恩赐，不是吗？

cues.en: No, the kind of spying I was thinking of was standing outside a woman's apartment at three o'clock in the morning to make sure she is not entertaining a man who might be charged with support for the children. But they're mostly abuses. You have a system which stimulates abuse. Aren't you evading the point that absent the abuses, you've still got a situation in which
cues.zh: 不，我所想的那种监视是，凌晨三点站在一个女性的公寓外面，确保她没有接待可能会被指控承担抚养孩子的男人。但这些大多是滥用职权。你有一个助长滥用职权的体制。难道你是在回避这样一个核心问题：即便没有这些滥用，你依然面临着这样一种局面：

cues.en: Somebody has got to concern himself over the administration of the family By somebody who's a member of the disorganized poor as I say elementary things like have they had their vaccination Let me let me take that let me go to that point as I would say first at the present time We're not doing it in the second place for a great large fraction of the people who are being helped They have the every incentive to do it themselves if we give them the money we will strengthen their responsibility third
cues.zh: 必须有人去关心家庭的管理工作，由那些来自无组织穷困群体的人来关心，就像我说的，那些最基本的事情，比如他们打过疫苗吗？让我来谈谈这一点，让我深入探讨一下，我想说的是，首先，目前我们并没有在做这件事；其次，对于获得帮助的绝大部分人来说，如果我们把钱给他们，他们完全有动力自己去做好，从而增强他们的责任感；第三

cues.en: under any system you're going to have hardship cases, you're going to have the special problems, you're going to have the people you talk about. One of the great virtues of the negative income tax, in my opinion, is that by taking off the mass burden of income maintenance, it would make it possible for private charitable organizations to do a useful function
cues.zh: 无论在什么体制下，你都会遇到困难案例，都会遇到特殊问题，都会遇到你所说的那些人。依我之见，负所得税的一大优点在于，通过卸下维护收入的大众负担，它将使民间慈善组织能够去发挥有益的作用

cues.en: of just the kind of thing you're talking about. I don't believe governmental civil servants can perform that function well. I believe the great virtue of private charity has always been that it was able to be individualized and it was able to go to the particular person. The welfare, the governmental welfare programs have destroyed private charity. Yes, but then of course the question arises as a political matter.
cues.zh: 去从事你刚才所说的那类事情。我不相信政府公务员能把这件事情做好。我认为私营慈善机构的一大优点一直在于，它能够做到因人而异，能够真正关照到特定的个人。福利，政府的福利项目已经摧毁了民间慈善。是的，但随之而来的自然是一个政治层面的问题。

cues.en: just as, for instance, you have written that one of the weaknesses of Keynesian fiscal policy is political. You know, it's hard to tax even in times of prosperity. But assuming that one were to launch the Friedman plan, isn't it likely in a democratic politics that you would end up increasing that lower level of guarantee to such a point as an effect to preempt the ad hoc...
cues.zh: 比如，你曾写道，凯恩斯财政政策的弱点之一是政治性的。你知道，即使在繁荣时期也很难征税。但假设要推行弗里德曼方案，在民主政治下，你最终很可能会把那个最低保障水平提高到如此程度，以致预先阻止了那些临时性的……

cues.en: supplements that would normally be given by a private and discriminating charity. As you know, in politics you can't win an election without a candidate. You can't beat a candidate without another candidate. And the situation now is the same. We're comparing alternatives. The question is, of various alternatives, which is more subject to this danger? And it seems to me experience suggests that our present welfare programs
cues.zh: 补充，而这些补充通常是由私人的、有鉴别力的慈善机构提供的。如你所知，在政治中，没有候选人就赢不了选举。没有另一个候选人就击败不了候选人。现在的情况也是一样。我们在比较各种替代方案。问题是，在各种替代方案中，哪一个更容易受到这种危险的影响？在我看来，经验表明，我们目前的福利项目

cues.en: are clearly very much subject to this danger. Look at what's been happening. In a period of unprecedented prosperity and affluence, the number of people on the welfare rolls has skyrocketed. Why? Because once they get on, we make it almost impossible for them to get off. In order for somebody who gets on to get off, he or she has to be able to have a really good job because to earn a little bit, get off gradually, now doesn't pay. Under a negative income tax, you would have people
